rationale: Shiza's hands-on work at the intersection of robotics, haptics, and applied ML complements Era's focus on edge intelligence and on-device AI — both are building toward embedded, privacy-preserving systems rather than cloud-dependent solutions. Shiza's mechanical engineering background and conviction that robotics deployment requires operators and industrialists aligns with Era's advocacy for sovereign, on-device intelligence, and both operate at the frontier of making advanced ML deployable in constrained environments.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Era Qian — you're both building at the edge of applied AI and robotics with a focus on deployment-first systems rather than centralized infrastructure.
